threads.body: This move removes the published `io.opentelemetry.instrumentation.guava.v10_0.GuavaAsyncOperationEndStrategy` API, including `create()` and `builder()`, along with its non-deprecated builder and standalone artifact. Applications that register this strategy without the agent have no replacement in the new agent-private package. Please retain and publish the library with deprecated public entry points first, and defer their removal to a later minor release.

replies.body: Immediate removal of this alpha artifact and its public strategy/builder APIs was explicitly approved as an exception to deprecation-first for this change. Retaining the library would contradict the requested agent-only consolidation. The non-stable breaking-change entry and PR description document the removal and lack of a replacement library API, and the PR has the breaking change label. No code change is needed.

threads.body: Please pin this helper-test dependency to Guava `10.0`. The relocated tests exercise ordinary completion, failure, and cancellation rather than a specific version-compatibility path, so `.orLatest()` does not meet the exception to the fixed-version rule in `.github/instructions/instrumentation-gradle.instructions.md:200-202`. Latest-version integration coverage remains in the existing agent suites.
